description.value: Glenwood Centre is a municipal community centre in Port Alberni operated by the City's Parks, Recreation & Culture department. It offers public drop-in programs and facility rentals, and is part of a broader network of recreation facilities in the Alberni Valley. The surrounding area features an extensive trail system popular with hikers and mountain bikers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (playinpa.ca) is the City of Port Alberni Parks, Recreation & Culture department site, not a dedicated Glenwood Centre page. The front page references 'Glenwood Public Drop-in Schedule for April to August 2026,' confirming the facility is active. However, no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are explicitly confirmed for the Glenwood Centre location. The website contact address (4255 Wallace Street) is for the department headquarters (Echo Centre), not Glenwood Centre at 4480 Vimy Street.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Glenwood Centre is an active municipal community centre, but the website (playinpa.ca) is the city-wide Parks & Rec portal with no dedicated page confirming cycling-relevant amenities at this specific location. None of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be verified from available evidence.

wow_evidence: Municipal community centre with public drop-in programs plus rentals — KW-PRIVATE is a false positive (drop-in confirmed).
blurb: Municipal community centre with public drop-in programs in Port Alberni.
